name: pixel-agents
description: A pixel-art dungeon crawler in the bottom panel where each active Claude Code agent session is a hero. Observe only: it never controls your agents.

enumDescriptions: Show simulated agents only while no real Claude Code session is detected.
Always show simulated agents, beside real sessions.
pixelAgents.simulator.markdownDescription: Simulated agents for a zero-configuration demo. Simulated agents are named `Sim ...` (ids start with `sim-`) and are **not** real sessions. `auto` shows them only while no real Claude Code session is detected.

pixelAgents.simulatorAgentCount.markdownDescription: Number of simulated agents (`Sim ...`) when the simulator runs.

enumDescriptions: Read only the transcripts of the folders open in this window.
Read the transcripts of every project on this machine.
pixelAgents.projectScope.markdownDescription: Which Claude Code project transcripts are read. `workspace` (default) reads only the sessions of the folders open in this window. `all` reads the transcripts of **every project on this machine**, in every window. Either way only session id, name, state, tool name, and timestamp are extracted, nothing is stored, and nothing leaves the machine. User or remote settings only.

pixelAgents.transcriptPath.markdownDescription: Root directory of Claude Code transcripts. Empty means `~/.claude/projects`. Must be an absolute path or start with `~/`. Read-only: nothing under it is ever written, and symbolic links below it are never followed. Set this if you relocated Claude Code's configuration directory. User or remote settings only.

pixelAgents.idleTimeoutSeconds.markdownDescription: Seconds of transcript silence before a working agent with no pending tool is shown as idle.

pixelAgents.toolTimeoutSeconds.markdownDescription: Seconds of transcript silence before a working agent with a pending tool (for example a long build) is shown as idle. Never less than `#pixelAgents.idleTimeoutSeconds#`.

pixelAgents.sessionEndTimeoutMinutes.markdownDescription: Minutes of transcript silence before a session counts as ended and its hero leaves. Never less than `#pixelAgents.toolTimeoutSeconds#`.

pixelAgents.debounceMs.markdownDescription: Milliseconds used to smooth state changes: the delay from spawn to the first state, the quiet time after a turn ends, and the per-agent update coalescing window.

pixelAgents.enemies.markdownDescription: Show enemies and stage progress. Off: the party marches in an empty corridor. Enemies are scenery: heroes take no damage either way.

pixelAgents.killsPerStage.markdownDescription: Enemies the party defeats in a stage before the stage boss appears.

pixelAgents.maxEnemies.markdownDescription: Most enemies on screen at once. Waves are also sized by the number of fighting heroes.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.webview.json && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json
